##### Project general facts

Greygate Residences by ADE is a contemporary residential building that combines a clean, minimalist architectural language with calm and refined interiors. The building rises above a ground floor and parking podium and offers studios and one-bedroom apartments, complemented by premium retail spaces at ground level. A minimalist main entrance, a welcoming reception and a light-filled main lobby create a sophisticated arrival, while passenger elevators and a dedicated service lift ensure efficient everyday movement.

Amenities are concentrated on the first floor and designed for relaxation and an active lifestyle. Residents can enjoy an outdoor swimming pool with a separate kids' pool, indoor and outdoor gyms equipped with modern exercise stations, and sauna rooms for rest and recovery. Families benefit from a safe children's play area with age-appropriate equipment, while a gazebo sitting area and outdoor seating surrounded by greenery provide quiet spaces for reading, socialising or spending time with family and friends.

Interiors feature open-plan living areas with contemporary design and integrated home automation that controls lighting, climate, security and curtains at the touch of a button. Kitchens are fitted with quality built-in appliances. Bedrooms offer heightened ceilings, large windows and generous storage, and bathrooms are finished with white wall tiling, porcelain flooring, mirror cabinets and high-quality fixtures, creating a calm, spa-like atmosphere.

##### Location description and benefits

Jumeirah Village Circle is a master-planned community at the heart of new Dubai, located between Al Khail Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road. It brings together apartments, villas and townhouses surrounded by lush greenery and parks, creating a family-friendly setting that balances urban convenience with a calmer suburban feel. Circle Mall serves as the community's main hub for shopping, dining and entertainment.

The two main highways provide quick connections to Dubai Marina, Mall of the Emirates, Palm Jumeirah, Burj Al Arab and Downtown Dubai, with both Dubai International Airport and Al Maktoum International Airport within reach. Residents have access to schools, nurseries, clinics, supermarkets, cafes and fitness centres across the community, along with walking paths and landscaped communal areas that encourage an active outdoor lifestyle.

Jumeirah Village Circle is a freehold community and one of Dubai's most active residential markets. Good value compared with neighbouring areas, strong rental demand and excellent road connectivity position the community as a prime investment destination. The area appeals equally to young professionals, families and investors focused on long-term rental income.
